text: Good morning, you have reached the customer care line. What can I do for you?

text: Hello, this is the reference implementation speaking.

text: حياك الله، موعدك بكرة الساعة التاسعة صباحًا.

text: حياك الله، حسابك على Netflix تم تجديده اليوم.

name: en_long
text: There are two ways to do this. You can either keep the current plan and add the extra seats one at a time, which bills at the standard rate, or you can move to the annual plan, which includes ten seats and works out cheaper if you expect the team to grow. I can apply either one before the end of today’s call.
